qs.q: A 28-year-old man with immune thrombocytopenia is scheduled to receive a platelet transfusion. Regarding blood group compatibility, which characteristic applies to platelet units?
o: Rh antigens are destroyed by the transfusion filter
Rh compatibility is strictly mandatory for all doses
Rh antigens are strongly expressed on platelets
Rh antigens are not present on platelets
qs.e: Rh antigens are not present on platelets, although units may contain residual red blood cells that require consideration. ABO matching is preferred, but Rh expression is absent on the platelets themselves.
